text: Commercial inventories, strategic reserves, and sanctioned oil stocks are reduced as Middle East shipping remains disrupted. U.S. diesel exports remain available, while emergency reserve releases and temporary domestic diesel measures remain active.

text: The 10-year Treasury yield reaches 5.35%, its highest since 2002, while the 30-year reaches 5.724% and the 2-year 4.818%. Treasury is offering $39 billion of 10-year notes amid elevated long-duration yields in the U.S. and European sovereign markets.

meta.note: Auction demand is unresolved at capture time; inflation and policy explanations are excluded.
